newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ to mull tax effect before policy change - OECD.
newsitem.headline: BOJ to mull tax effect before policy change - OECD.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) is likely to assess the impact of fiscal consolidation measures before making any policy changes, Kumiharu Shigehara, deputy secretary-general of the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), said on Monday.

Shigehara, who until recently was the OECD's chief economist, did not specify whether there was a chance of the BOJ changing its monetary policy, but said: "The BOJ will watch the effect of fiscal reform measures and other economic factors."
He also said signs of inflation are unlikely to arise in Japan in the near future.
"Inflation concerns will not arise (in Japan) in 1997 or 1998," he told a news conference in Tokyo.
